ptt_settings.setting: false Enable or disable the PTT service. The default is false.
1 Numeric Identifier of default profile. Decimal value : min=1.
false Ignore keys in lock mode. The default is false.
None Log level: None, Error, Warning, Info, Debug. The default is None.
PTT Log Directory: Path on SDCard to store PTT Log Files.
false Enable/Disable CDR logs. Default is false
5000 Size of CDR log in KB. Default is 5000, Minimum is 100 and Maximum is 25000
true Allows PTT to coexist with full duplex clients
true Allows full duplex incoming calls to vibrate when PTT is in call

setting.name: profileSwitchKey
setting.description: Key for making profile switch. Contains two parts. 1. the key code 2. Single/Double Click. The parts are separated by hyphen.

ptt_settings.setting: true Allow profile switch from UI
true Allow profile switch using Key
239.192.2.2 Multicast address to be used for Group Broadcast communications.
5000 IP Port number of the multicast address being used for Group Broadcast communications. Decimal value : min = 1024, max = 49151
4080 SIP IP Port to be used for Private Response communications. Decimal value : min = 1024, max = 49151
3 One group call packet holds 200 ms data. Decimal value : min = 2, max = 4, default = 3 : which means the maximum data the jitter holds is 600 ms.
3 One private call packet holds 100 ms data. Decimal value : min = 2, max = 4, default = 3 : which means the maximum data the jitter holds is 300 ms

60000 In a group call, the amount of time the user is allowed to hold the floor (talk without interruption). Decimal value in milliseconds : disable = 0. min=10000 ms, max=90000 ms, default = 60000 ms

60000 In a private call, the amount of time the user is allowed to hold the floor in the private call (talk without interruption). Decimal value in milliseconds: disable = 0. min=10000 ms, max=90000 ms, default = 60000 ms

10000 The amount of time that has to elapse after which a Private Response cannot be made to the last known talker in the session. Decimal value in milliseconds : min=1000ms, max=10000ms. default = 10000 ms
10000 The amount of time that has to elapse after which the Private Response will terminate. Decimal value in milliseconds : min=1000ms, max=10000ms. default = 10000 ms

120000 The amount of time that has to elapse after which the device will come out of mute state. Decimal value in milliseconds : 0 implies an infinite switch, min=0ms max=8640000ms. default = 120000ms
R2 The Head Set Key

profile.description: id is the Profile Identifier (1-12). name assigns an ASCII string name to the profile. 16 alphanumeric character string, including symbols, textual name. This name will be displayed on the UI. The value for language attribute should be a locale string defined as per http://developer.android.com/reference/java/util/Locale.html.
profile.setting: false Disable or enable private call. Default is false.
Default Off to disable the feature, Default to play the Profile/Channel names while switching.
true If this parameter is true, the device will only listen on the channel it is set to transmit upon. i.e. that scan only the HOME channel (as in 1.1).

0 The amount of time that has to elapse after which the current channel will change from Alternative Channel to Home Channel. 0 implies an infinite switch. Decimal value in milliseconds : min=0, max=8640000
false The value true implies that the per channel priority settings will be honored, else it will be ignored
false Allow PTT to be enabled/disabled from UI. The default is false.
1 Set as 0 to use soft key for GC and PC. Set as 1 to use hard keys as defined by key codes in XML for Group Call, Private Call
L2-Single,R2-Single Key for making Group Call. Contains two parts. 1. the key code 2. Single/Double Click. The parts are separated by hyphen.
L2-Double,R2-Double Key for making Private Call. Contains two parts. 1. the key code 2. Single/Double Click. The parts are separated by hyphen.

setting.name: alternativeChannelSwitchKey
setting.description: Key for making alternative channel switch. Contains two parts. 1. the key code 2. Single/Double Click. The parts are separated by hyphen.

profile.setting: 600 One key timer delay. Decimal value in milliseconds : min = 400 ms, max = 1000 ms, default = 600 ms.
true Allow channel switch from UI
true Allow channel switch using Key
false Allow mute operation from UI
false Allow mute operation using Key

channel_list.description: Channel- list : List of channels in the profile, with following attributes. Channel Attributes: id - Channel identifier. Decimal value : min = 1, max = 32 name - An ASCII string name to the channel. 16 alphanumeric character string, including symbols, textual name. This name will be displayed on the UI. priority -The priority of the channel. Decimal value : min = 1, max = 32. 1 being highest, 32 lowest type - Home/Alternative/Emergency/Scan/Disabled. Channels that are not mentioned in the list will be disabled from scan group and from UI, replyable - if set to t rue, allows a channel to be in a conversation in response to an inbound traffic on this channel, preemptor - When set to true, a preemptor channel of higher priority can preempt a conversation on lower priority channel
